cues: Electrons are jumping straight from zinc atoms to copper ions, and all that energy is wasted as heat.
What if we could make those electrons travel through a wire instead?
Then the same reaction would light a bulb.
That is the whole idea of a battery, and by the end of this lesson, we will build one.
